isolation: unshare user and network namespaces; loopback interface only; disposable HOME, CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR and work directories
fixture: synthetic user settings.json SessionStart command touches a disposable marker
conclusion: The ordinary adapter created a native session and ran the synthetic user SessionStart hook. The guarded adapter started the native process and rejected the account-free session without running the hook.
limits: The guarded session lacked a subscription account. Rejection may itself prevent SessionStart, so this comparison does not isolate settingSources as the cause or prove hook suppression in an admitted session. Source inspection separately establishes settingSources: [] in the guarded SDK configuration. No real account, credential, prompt, relay or room agent was used.
